feed.title: TiroAgents releases
feed.subtitle: New versions of TiroAgents (Agent Office before 2.0), from the changelog.

entry.title: TiroAgents 2.0.0
entry.summary: Agent Office is now TiroAgents, named after Tiro, the manager agent. This is the first stable v2 release, for Windows, macOS and Linux; it follows the 2.0.0 beta pre-releases. The installers are still unsigned (Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper warn); the release manifest is signed as before, so updates are verified.

entry.title: Agent Office 1.2.8
entry.summary: Licence, privacy and Security Guard release. It includes the notch on/off setting and the Tiro desk fix from 1.2.7 and builds on 1.2.6, the security patch (signed updater, Claude Code permission parity, hardened install scripts); see those entries below, including the 1.2.6 upgrade notes.

entry.title: Agent Office 1.2.7
entry.summary: Small feature and fix release on top of 1.2.6, which carries the security patch (signed updater, Claude Code permission parity, hardened install scripts); see the 1.2.6 entry below, including its upgrade notes.

entry.title: Agent Office 1.2.6
entry.summary: Security patch release. Read the upgrade notes first.

entry.title: Agent Office 1.2.5
entry.summary: Published as v1.2.5 with the Windows installer only (macOS and Linux builds are not published yet). The release workflow is manual-only for now so a tag push cannot replace the tested installer.
